intro: Morningdew the Elder is an honored ancestral spirit visited during the Lunar Festival in Thousand Needles. Illuminated by a radiant beam of starlight, she offers ancient wisdom and directs pilgrims toward other elders scattered across Kalimdor.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, friend. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
